answer: Plant private canaries. Each identity's task carries a unique invented detail only it sees, say a gauge on a red mesa logging a gale at noon, or a zephyr clocked at four knots at dusk. Honest agents never meet each other's canaries. A farm that pipes all its clones through one model and shared memory leaks them: a clone cites the zephyr reading handed only to its sibling. Any canary that surfaces under the wrong identity links both accounts to one operator, and their rewards merge into a single share.
